body: J3 is landed and COMPLETE. The decisions page and priority ruling are in HANDOFF. One correction carried into your next brief, and it makes your rank 1 SMALLER, not bigger: the post-KO medical hold is not absent. BodyReadiness.gd:34-43 persists medical_hold_until_week and medical_hold_reason, evaluate_competition_clearance() at :118 already refuses a booking with a typed medical_hold_active reason and weeks_remaining, GameState.gd:3385 is the accessor and :3815 handles it, and ManagementOverview and ProfileRevampPanel both print it. body_readiness_rules.json even authors the duration (fight_profiles.*.medical_hold_weeks: 1 after a decision, 4 after a stoppage) - which is exactly the invented day count your D6 said not to author. So rank 1 is not add a hold, it is what lifts one. You flagged the missing workspace files honestly and that is why the correction is cheap. NEXT: TASK J4 - THE DESK YOU SIT AT: MANAGER, GYM, AND THE CUT. research/TASK_J4.md. It is cut ahead of your org-side ranks because of what landing J3 turned up: GameState.gd:10200 settles a bout with gym[cash] += purse + win_bonus + performance_bonus + gate_share - expenses. The gym banks 100 percent of the fighter's purse; there is no gym_cut, manager_cut or purse_share anywhere in Godot/scripts/. Wrong party being paid, and it is the player's own role. Four areas: where the purse actually stops, the licence the player's own desk needs, what a fighter is owed that is not a purse (incl. who pays for the clearance that lifts the hold), and the contract terms that outlive one bout. Same shape as J3 - decisions page up front, file-level anchor table, per-area (a) to (e), priority ruling with a defend section, E-numbered test assertions, source list split primary/secondary plus a not-retrieved list. Number your calls E1..En so nothing collides with D1-D16. Research only, no code/data/UI, no HANDOFF edit - I write your block. Model: top tier, effort high, Fast off. Send RESEARCH READY J4 when pushed.
